notes.title: Starting the production of Deep Down! FOLLOW US AND WISHLIST NOW
notes.content:
After several months of design, playtesting and prototyping, we've reached our next milestone as we prepare to officially begin the production of Devil Studio's first video game. 

Our goal: Creating different and outside the norm card games that have a positive emotionnal impact on the people who play them. 

Follow us in Deep Down's next developments to discover its uniquely constructed universe where cards represent the complexity of human relationships.

Thank you for your support!
The Devil Studio's team
